purpose: Teach: 漂っ/見当たら/神さま/ひまわり/ペットボトル/なぞ/吸う/はじまっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、店内、コーヒーの香り、いつも漂ってて、最高だね。
lines.en: Aoi, the way the coffee smell just lingers in here all the time—it's perfect.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative. Soft opening. Lets the thought settle naturally. A small smile in the voice—she's genuinely pleased, not trying to impress.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。注文票、見当たらなくて、慌てちゃったよ、さっき。
lines.en: Yeah. I lost the order slip earlier and kind of panicked.
lines.style: Rueful laugh underneath. Self-deprecating but not dwelled-on. Quick pace, moving past it. The tone says 'you know how it is.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 結婚のこと、神さまに、お願いしてるの、最近、私。
lines.en: I've been praying to god lately about marriage, actually.
lines.style: Vulnerable admission. Quiet, steady voice—not looking for reaction, just saying it aloud. Slight pause before the word 'marriage' like she's deciding whether to say it out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店先に、ひまわり、植えるの、お洒落でいいね。
lines.en: The sunflowers you planted out front are really lovely—so stylish.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, brighter now. Appreciative energy returning. Not performative—she actually noticed and cares enough to say it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、ペットボトルじゃなくて、マイボトル、持ち歩いてるの、私。
lines.en: I've been carrying a reusable bottle lately instead of plastic ones.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Slight deliberation—like she's noticing this about herself as she says it. Not boastful, just an observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 彼の気持ち、なぞが多いんだよね、メイちゃん、本当に。
lines.en: There's so much about how he feels that I just can't figure out, Mei. Really.
lines.style: Gentle concern beneath. Warm toward Mei, but with an undercurrent of worry. Slows on 'can't figure out'—acknowledging the real puzzle. Eyes on her, not looking away.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 喫煙、もう、吸うの、やめたって、彼、言ってたよ。
lines.en: He said he's already quit smoking.
lines.style: Lighter now. Brighter note—good news. Quick, delivered matter-of-factly, but with an undertone of 'see, he's trying.'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 梅雨、もうはじまった感じだよね、洗濯物、困るわ。
lines.en: It feels like rainy season's already started, doesn't it? The laundry situation is killing me.
lines.style: Rueful, tired but not complaining hard. Quick shift back to the practical. The tone says 'welcome to early June.'
